topic: External Light Control System - Direction Light Status and Error Monitoring
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface for querying or subscribing to the status of direction lights (including error states and operational modes).
column_semantics: The columns represent different aspects of the service interface: the first column is the service name, followed by consumption type (SOA/ICB), and finally the hardware platform (S32G-8295).

core_entities.name: ExteriorLightControlSystem
core_entities.description: The main system responsible for controlling external lights, including direction lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightSts
core_entities.description: Service interface to query the current operational status of direction lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_entities.description: Service interface to query the fault status of direction lights.

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightSts
core_outputs.description: Indicates the current operational mode of the direction lights (e.g., no flash, left flash, right flash, both sides flash, unknown).

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_outputs.description: Indicates whether there is an error in the direction light system (0x0 = No Error, 0x1 = Error).

core_faults.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_faults.description: Represents the fault state of the direction light system, with values indicating either no error or an error condition.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for querying the status and fault conditions of direction lights within the Exterior Light Control System. It can be used to verify that the system correctly reports the operational mode and fault status of direction lights under various conditions.
